# Vocabulary: fidelity

How closely the model tracks real-world causal structure. Independent of graphics.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `abstract` | Abstract | Real-world referent is symbolic; a handful of variables stand in for a whole domain. |
| `stylized` | Stylized | Recognizable real-world causes with deliberate simplification for play. |
| `systemic` | Systemic | Many interacting subsystems with plausible causal links; outcomes emerge from rules rather than scripts. |
| `high-fidelity` | High-fidelity | Quantitative models calibrated against real data (aerodynamics, tire models, market data). |
| `professional` | Professional-grade | Used or certified for real training or analysis outside entertainment. |
